summary: Complete end-to-end testing of FIREARTRO landing page: backend /api/quotes endpoints (5/5 tests pass) and all critical frontend flows including quote form submission with MongoDB persistence, package CTA prefill, gallery lightbox, FAQ accordion, portfolio carousel, navbar smooth scroll, and legal pages. All critical features work as expected.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — a11y console warning only (non-blocking). Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for screen reader users.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside the gallery lightbox to silence the Radix a11y warning.

(Optional) Hero CTAs use data-testid 'hero-primary-cta' / 'hero-secondary-cta' rather than the names mentioned in the request ('hero-cta-quote'/'hero-cta-shows'). Functionally they work — note the naming difference.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id via .find({}, {'_id': 0}) and Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore'). Good.
QuoteForm uses prefill-package CustomEvent listener — verified working: clicking package-cta-1 sets the Pachet select to 'Pachet Drone Show' and the saved quote in MongoDB reflects this.
All env vars used correctly: backend MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from .env, frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Section IDs (#acasa, #servicii, #spectacole, #pachete, #galerie, #intrebari, #contact) all present and reachable via smooth scroll.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed quote records in MongoDB 'quotes' collection during E2E submission test. Total quotes in DB after run: 4. Safe to keep or clean later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified end-to-end on https://web-storytelling.preview.emergentagent.com. Quote submission verified to persist in MongoDB via curl GET /api/quotes. Package CTA prefill flow works — window CustomEvent 'prefill-package' correctly sets the Pachet dorit select. Gallery lightbox uses Radix Dialog (logs a11y warning re: DialogTitle but is functional). Hero CTAs are 'hero-primary-cta'/'hero-secondary-cta'. Stats section exists with testid 'stats-section' but individual count-up numbers do not have per-stat testids (4 numbers do render and animate visually).

frontend_flows_verified: Home page loads with 0 page errors (only 1 Radix a11y warning re: DialogTitle in lightbox)
4/4 package cards + CTAs; package-cta-1 prefills select to 'Pachet Drone Show'
8/8 gallery items render; gallery-item-0 click opens gallery-lightbox dialog
FAQ accordion has 8 triggers; first expands aria-expanded=true
Quote form validation: empty submit shows toast 'Completează numele, telefonul și tipul evenimentului.'
Quote form submission: POST /api/quotes returns saved quote with id, success toast shown, quote-success card visible with 'Mulțumim!' text; verified persisted via GET /api/quotes
WhatsApp float + final CTA have correct wa.me/40700000000 href
Legal pages /legal/confidentialitate, /legal/termeni, /legal/cookies render correct H1 titles; legal-back link returns to home
